definitions.explanation: At some point in the future.
Used when referring to one among several options.
Regardless of which option or outcome.

notes:
いずれ functions as both an adverb (someday) and a pronoun (which/either). It has a slightly formal or literary tone.

AS ADVERB (someday):
- いずれ⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: you'll understand eventually
- いずれ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧: again someday
- いずれ⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦うち→うち：01328_uchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: sometime soon

AS PRONOUN (which/either):
- ⟦いずれも→いずれも：16830_izuremo⟧: both, all of them
- ⟦いずれか→いずれか：22057_izureka⟧: one of them, either

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いずれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: in any case, either way
- いずれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦せよ→する：00392_suru⟧: in any case (slightly more formal)
- いずれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧: either way (slightly casual)

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. Can also appear as {何|いず}れ in formal writing.

REGISTER:
More formal than ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧ (someday, casual) or ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ (which one, everyday).
